subject: Manchester City lose three league games in a row, losing 3-1 at Nottingham Forest
title: Seven wins, then three defeats

lines.vo: Seven wins in a row. Then three straight league defeats.
lines.footage: Manchester City highlights, city wide shot

lines.vo: Manchester City lost three-one at Nottingham Forest. It was Forest's first home win of the season.
City were the guest of honour. Liam Delap scored twice, and Jair Cunha got the other.
Rayan Cherki scored for City. One goal is not a comeback.
ESPN says a mistake at the back led to the first goal. Defending was clearly optional.
City are six points behind Arsenal. Maresca's first season just got interesting.
Three league defeats in a row. At City, that is basically a national emergency.
Who wins the next one? News, betting tips and predictions at aboutfootball dot UK.
